dedupe_keys.name: china biomass resource and bioenergy potential

description: The China biomass resource research team publishes spatial biomass and bioenergy potential maps for energy planning. The collection supplies agricultural and forestry residues, energy crops on marginal land and abandoned cropland, and five development scenarios. GeoTIFF maps use WGS84 at approximately 1 km, or 30 arc-seconds, with two NetCDF aggregates and a provincial Excel summary. The resource-breakdown file contains 36 variables; the scenario file contains five energy-potential variables. Access is free, and inspected aggregate and example components state CC0. These inputs can constrain biomass capacity and fuel availability in simulations such as model-pypsa. A caveat is that resource potential is not an observed sustainable delivery rate or a guaranteed supply contract. The collection metadata do not specify all observation dates, and this review did not inspect every raster component or download values. Land availability and conversion assumptions require checking before scenario use.
